items.title: Solo Wedding Project: Bird (Film Full Photo) Captures Self-Love with the Lomomatic 110
items.excerpt: Thai photographer Bird, also known as Film Full Photo, uses the Lomomatic 110 to bring her Solo Wedding concept to life – a personal project created to share the idea that “Happiness doesn't depend on someone else – it begins with ourselves.”

items.title: Collecting Mailbox Memories: Stories from the Lomographers’ Print Exchange
items.excerpt: Meet five Lomographers from Latvia, Spain, Italy, Brazil, and Argentina as they each share what they sent and received for the Lomographers' Print Exchange.

items.title: Recap: Birmingham Design Festival LomoWalk
items.excerpt: 2026-08-03 #people#places![Image 3: Recap: Birmingham Design Festival LomoWalk](https://www.lomography.com/magazine/358672-recap-birmingham-design-festival-lomowalk) We brought a bit of Lomography magic to Birmingham Design Festival in the form of a LomoApparat LomoWalk complete with a mix of films and a lot of messing about. See some of the incredible results here and find out what participant Lauren Skillman had to say about the day.

items.title: New Kids: An Analogue Investigation of Contemporary Adolescence in Bologna by James Beghelli
items.excerpt: What happens when a photographer relinquishes control and allows teenagers to tell their own stories? In New Kids, James Beghelli gives Simple Use Cameras to young people in Bologna, turning film into a tool for exploration and self-expression.

items.title: Day vs Night: Testing the Half-frame Simple Use Reloadable Film Camera Under Changing Light
items.excerpt: Lomography writers @francinegaebriele and @nate_soriano take the Half-frame Simple Use Reloadable Film Camera on a day-versus-night run to see how it captures the changing light throughout an entire day.

items.title: The Extremes, Existentialism, and Artistry Behind Early X-Ray Photography
items.excerpt: What has the history of the x-ray got to do with experimental photography? More than meets the eye! This historical In Depth reveals some of the strange situations behind the scientific discovery of the x-ray, which shaped photography in daring and dangerous ways.

items.title: Lomography Partners: Share Your Story – Altrincham, Greater Manchester, UK
items.excerpt: Share Your Story in the UK is all about removing the barriers to storytelling. Store runner Simon Hepburn talks about the analogue-driven principles that fueled the shop's conception, and its growing creative community.

items.title: Akiyama Film Takes Us Into the Vintage Corners of Hong Kong and Tainan with the Lomo MC-A
items.excerpt: Akiyama Film is back! Testing the new Lomo MC-A 35 mm camera with Lomography film, the team explored the retro streets of Hong Kong and Tainan to capture a raw, nostalgic vibe. Check out their results!

items.title: Pre Death Do Us Part: A Work in Progress by Jason Osayamen with the Joseph Petzval 55 f/1.7 Focus-coupled Bokeh Control Art Lens
items.excerpt: 2026-07-30 #news#videos![Image 9: Pre Death Do Us Part: A Work in Progress by Jason Osayamen with the Joseph Petzval 55 f/1.7 Focus-coupled Bokeh Control Art Lens](https://www.lomography.com/magazine/356766-pre-death-do-us-part-a-work-in-progress-by-jason-osayamen-with-the-joseph-petzval-55-f-1-7-focus-coupled-bokeh-control-art-lens) Jason Osayamen is working on his debut feature film, “Pre Death Do Us Part”, a psychological thriller set in Nigeria. He has been using the Joseph Petzval 55 f/1.7 Art Lens to complement the film's visual language, and talks about his ongoing project in this interview.

items.title: First Impressions: Tree's Thailand Travel Snapshots with the Half-frame Simple Use Reloadable Film Camera
items.excerpt: We handed the new Half-frame Simple Use Reloadable Film Camera Classicolor to Tree, inviting her to document her travels across Thailand. After her trip, we talked about the journey, the camera, and how film keeps memories fresh.

items.title: The Soft and the Strong: Rebeca Morimoto and Her Customized La Sardina Camera & Flash DIY
items.excerpt: Big applause for the La Sardina by Rebeca Morimoto! The Peruvian Japanese illustrator brings her iconic style to this unique, customizable camera, giving La Sardina the punk, tattooed makeover she always deserved.

items.title: Clubhouse Paradiso Capture Scotland’s World Cup in Boston on the ActionSampler
items.excerpt: 2026-07-27 #people#videos![Image 13: Clubhouse Paradiso Capture Scotland’s World Cup in Boston on the ActionSampler](https://www.lomography.com/magazine/358935-clubhouse-paradiso-capture-scotland-s-world-cup-in-boston-on-the-actionsampler) The World Cup fever isn't over! We take a look at Ralph McClure and Keir Reid of Clubhouse Paradiso's visit to Boston for Scotland’s World Cup campaign, where the Glasgow-based duo created some stop animations of the events using the ActionSampler.

items.title: Dreamy Portraits & Vibrant Colors: Riccardo Montanini with the LomoChrome Classicolor 35 mm ISO 200
items.excerpt: Riccardo Montanini puts the new LomoChrome Classicolor ISO 200 to the test by capturing two contrasting worlds in a dual-themed portrait series, shot with the Petzval lens. Find out his first impressions in this interview.

items.title: Recap: London Graphic Centre LomoWalk
items.excerpt: 2026-07-26 #news![Image 15: Recap: London Graphic Centre LomoWalk](https://www.lomography.com/magazine/358671-recap-london-graphic-centre-lomowalk) We teamed up with London Graphic Centre for another fun-packed LomoApparat LomoWalk around Covent Garden and Soho using a mix of Lomography films.

items.title: Pride Parade Moments with the Lomography Half-Frame Simple Use Camera
items.excerpt: This year's Pride month, Lomography staff from across the globe attended Pride parades organized by their respective local communities, and capturing with them scenes of solidarity was the new Half-Frame Simple Use Camera, pre-loaded with Classicolor 200.

items.title: Whispers of the Summer Forest: Videographer Jihu Kim’s Dreamlike Imagery with the Joseph Petzval 27 mm f/1.7
items.excerpt: Jihu Kim headed into the forest with the Joseph Petzval 27 mm f/1.7 Focus-Coupled Art Lens to capture dreamlike scenes. Using the lens’s unique swirly bokeh and immersive wide-angle perspective, he beautifully translated the feeling of being drawn into nature.

items.title: Film Photography in Tune with Music: Meet Argenteurs
items.excerpt: 2026-07-24 #culture![Image 18: Film Photography in Tune with Music: Meet Argenteurs](https://www.lomography.com/magazine/358781-film-photography-in-tune-with-music-meet-argenteurs) From the Lomo MC-A on stage to the Lomography Color Negative ISO 400 film for a single cover, Argenteurs takes us behind the scenes of their analogue photography practice, using film to bring artists’ worlds to life and create lasting images.

items.title: Analogue Journal: Printing Memories with Artist Cat Caldarola (@talllcatart)
items.excerpt: Brooklyn-based artist Cat Caldarola shares how instant photography, journaling, and printmaking come together to preserve memories and inspire their creative practice.

items.title: Analogue Meets Subway Systems: Dami1992 Shooting on Colour Negative Film
items.excerpt: In this interview, David, a Czech photographer, introduces his fascination with metro stations and other liminal spaces. He also shares his experience working with Lomography Color Negative film, and offers advice on street photography.

items.title: First Rolls with the Half-frame Simple Use Reloadable Film Camera: Lomography Manila
items.excerpt: Get a glimpse of the Lomography Manila team's first adventure with the Half-frame Simple Use Reloadable Film Camera.

items.title: LomoWalk Recap: A City Color Experiment with Lomo MC-A
items.excerpt: We're used to Shanghai's skyline of towering skyscrapers – and to overthinking every shot before pressing the shutter. But this time, we flipped the script. We set out with a simple task: pick a color, wander, and let the city speak for itself on film.

items.title: Nicole Tecchio's Analogue Journal: A Visual Diary of an Illustrator's “Casa Vacanze”
items.excerpt: Take a look at Nicole Tecchio’s analogue journal where instant photography becomes a game of memory, imagination, and everyday storytelling.

items.title: Creators in Focus: How Images Evolve Through Lisa Brussell's Alternative Printing Processes
items.excerpt: This edition of Creators in Focus features American artist Lisa Brussell, who combines different alternative printing processes to create richly layered frames.

items.title: In Depth: Raucously Red Film Rhapsodies
items.excerpt: Inspired by the colors of the Community, I decided to spice things up a little. In this In Depth piece, I get into the history of the color red, from the caves to the big screen, from revolution to film rolls.

items.title: Behind the Scenes of “Stessa Direzione”: Paolo Santambrogio and the Music Video Shot with Joseph Petzval Art Lenses
items.excerpt: Between Los Angeles and the Mojave Desert, photographer and filmmaker Paolo Santambrogio created the music video for Paola Iezzi's Stessa Direzione with the Joseph Petzval Lenses. We interviewed him to take a behind-the-scene look at a journey through cinema, memories, and visions.

items.title: First Impressions: Mateusz Zimnoch on Trying Out the Lomo MC-A
items.excerpt: From a childhood fascination with an old Zenit camera to trying out the Lomo MC-A, Mateusz has always stayed close to analogue photography. Dive into this interview to see how he puts this unique point-and-shoot to the test and captures the raw, nostalgic beauty of everyday moments.

items.title: First Rolls with the Half-frame Simple Use Reloadable Film Camera: Lomography Vienna
items.excerpt: Get a glimpse of the Lomography Vienna team's first adventure with the Half-frame Simple Use Reloadable Film Camera.

items.title: A Day With RIKI: Lead Singer of Taiwanese Disco Band RIKI Lands in Japan with the Lomo'Instant Automat Glass
items.excerpt: RIKI is an increasingly popular authentic Taiwanese disco band. We invited leader singer Riki to document his time traveling between music festivals with the Lomo’Instant Automat Glass.

items.title: In the Frame: Into the Water
items.excerpt: This edition of our photography prompt series is all about action. It's the height of summer and we know what this means – swimsuits on, sun high up, heads underwater. We dare our Community to shoot the wackiest of beach or pool shots, and capture the season at its liveliest!

items.title: Family History in 20,000 Found Negatives: Jon Olav Stokke on Becoming an Accidental Archivist
items.excerpt: An unexpected treasure, obscured overseas travels, a meeting that should have happened earlier, and the last picnic no one knew would be the last recorded on film. Jon Olav Stokke’s family photography archive holds many such stories, recently rescued from a fate of gathering dust in the attic.
